one_liner: Paygent Connect (gopaygent.com) is a payments platform with a REST API, bearer API keys (pgt_live_...), webhooks and a sandbox, plus a free plan. Evidence is mixed with other unrelated "Paygent" products.
auth_notes: The gopaygent.com curl example sends a static bearer key (pgt_live_...) in the Authorization header. No OAuth is shown.
access_notes: The gopaygent.com homepage says "No credit card required. Free plan available." and lists sandbox testing. The draft's pricing-page quote (sandbox free, $15/mo production) is not in the fetched pages, so it is unverified here. Whether the free plan includes API keys is not confirmed on the fetched pages.
blocker_notes: The main risk is identity. Several unrelated "Paygent" products appear in the evidence (api.paygent.tech virtual cards with an MCP server, docs.withpaygent.com, paygent.to). The MCP server found belongs to a different product, not gopaygent.com. No gopaygent MCP was seen, but its docs were not fetched, so this is unverified.
